description: Co-Designing Stormwater Adaptations Through Community-Informed Urban Pluvial Flood Modeling is a data set deposited in DOE Pacific Northwest National Laboratory (PNNL) Repository by its authors Ava Spangler (Pennsylvania State University). This repository contains all inputs and code required to recreate the associated Spangler et al., 2026 publication. The figures directory contains the analysis figures in the manuscript, as well as a shapefile of the study area. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
